xabi.title: Hi, I'm Xabi
xabi.p1: My name is Xabi Gondra; I’m a local surfer from Mundaka, and my connection to the ocean began when I was just five years old. Since then, this sport has become my absolute passion and my way of life. Growing up in a place like Mundaka shapes your path, and starting my own surf school is the fulfillment of a dream I’ve been working toward for many years.
xabi.p2: Teaching has been part of my daily life since I was 16, when I started giving surf lessons. I enjoy sharing my knowledge, training with students, and guiding their progress in the water while maintaining a deep respect for the marine environment. To ensure the highest standards of safety and professionalism in my work, I hold an official certification as a surf instructor and am trained in lifesaving and first aid. If you want to learn or improve your technique, see you in the water.
xabi.photoAlt: Xabi with his surfboard in Mundaka

meta.title: Our story — Mundaka Surf Academy
meta.description: The story of Mundaka Surf Academy, a surf school in Mundaka, Bizkaia.

about.title: Our story
about.p1: Mundaka Surf Academy was born out of a lifelong passion and the enthusiasm of a young boy who always dreamed of having his own surf school and devoting himself entirely to the ocean. Founded by a 20-year-old local surfer who has been riding the waves since he was five, the academy has established itself as a place where experience in the water combines with professionalism to offer high-quality instruction.
about.p2: Although the project began as a personal initiative, this school would not be possible without the support of lifelong friends, who are part of the team as certified instructors. We share a common vision of surfing, rooted in years of experience in the water and a commitment to providing rigorous, safe instruction tailored to each student, backed by official training in instruction, lifeguarding, and first aid.
about.p3: Beyond the sport itself, at Mundaka Surf Academy we maintain a deep connection and absolute respect for the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve and the Mundaka coastline. We view our environment as a home that must be cared for and protected, instilling in every class a respect for the currents, the tides, and the area’s maritime culture. Here, you don’t just learn to ride waves—you learn to understand and experience the ocean with the seriousness it deserves.
about.note: To come: the academy will send high-quality photos of Mundaka and the school later.
about.photoAlt: The Santa Catalina hermitage on the rocks of Mundaka
about.lead: A surf school at one of Europe’s most famous waves, right inside the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve.

wave.title: The left wave of Mundaka
wave.p1: Mundaka is not just a wave; it is a living legend in global surfing. Located within the Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve, this left-hander is widely regarded as one of the most perfect, longest, and most aesthetic waves on the planet. When conditions align, Mundaka delivers a hollow, heavy, and incredibly long barrel running along the rivermouth's sandbar, making it the ultimate destination for advanced and professional surfers.
wave.p2: Mundaka's magic stems from a precise combination of estuarine geodynamics and seabed bathymetry. The outflow of the Urdaibai river deposits sediments that shape an exact sandbar where Atlantic swells enter the mouth of the estuary and break with immense power. The wave breaks initially with tremendous force and opens up a massive wall that can run for 300 to 400 meters on optimal days, allowing surfers to slot into barrel after barrel as the wave accelerates across the shallow water sheet. It works best on low to mid-tide, requiring specific northwest or north swell directions to unlock its full potential.
wave.altB: A surfer inside a blue barrel in Mundaka
wave.altC: A surfer on a green wall
wave.p3: What makes Mundaka truly special is its technical consistency and the blistering speed generated inside the barrel. Because it breaks over sand, it requires millimeter-precise wave reading and absolute mastery of take-off and positioning against the sheer power of the water. It is a pure, demanding, world-class left that challenges the best surfers in the international arena.
wave.p4: Mundaka’s fame crossed borders decades ago, establishing itself as a global benchmark and serving for years as the legendary home of the Billabong Pro Mundaka, one of the most prestigious stops on the professional world surfing tour (ASP/WSL). World legends such as Andy Irons, Kelly Slater, and Mark Occhilupo have hailed this wave as an absolute favorite. Protected and surfed with deep respect by the local Basque community, Mundaka represents the purest essence of northern surfing: authenticity, lineup etiquette, and an unbreakable connection with the sea.

urdaibai.title: Urdaibai Biosphere Reserve
urdaibai.p1: Located in the heart of Urdaibai, our school operates within one of Europe's most privileged and unique natural environments. Designated a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in 1984, this protected area features a breathtaking mosaic of marshes, estuaries, cliffs, and beaches of extraordinary ecological and scenic value. The Urdaibai river flows into a unique estuary that not only supports unmatched biodiversity and migratory wildlife, but also acts as the direct geographical engine shaping Mundaka's legendary sandbar. Surfing here means connecting with a protected territory of incalculable value, where absolute respect for the environment and nature conservation are part of our daily identity.

meta.description: Mundaka Surf Academy booking and cancellation conditions: 15% deposit online, the rest at the school.

conditions.title: Booking and cancellation conditions
conditions.lead: Bookings, payments, cancellations, delays and health: what to know before you book.

items.deposit: Mandatory deposit: to confirm any booking for lessons or courses, an online payment of 15% of the total is required at the time of booking.
items.balance: Remaining balance (85%): if you only paid the 15% deposit, the remaining 85% is paid in person at the school, before or after the class, by cash or card.
items.how: You receive a confirmation email; the academy receives your booking too.
items.cancel: Cancel 24 hours or more ahead: full refund; within 24 hours: no refund.
items.weather: Weather or force majeure: if the academy cancels because of adverse weather, a safety alert or force majeure, you choose between a new date or a full refund.
items.noshow: No-shows: not showing up at the scheduled time without notice means losing the session, with no refund.
items.full: Optional full payment: if you prefer, you can pay 100% of the booking online in advance.
items.cancel24: 24 hours or more in advance: full refund of the amount paid (the 15% deposit or the 100% payment).
items.cancelLate: Less than 24 hours: no refund of the deposit or the amount paid. With 24 hours we organise staff schedules, assign instructors and prepare equipment; a late cancellation makes it impossible to reorganise them.
items.late: Delays: there is a 15-minute grace period. If you call ahead we will try to accommodate you; more than 15 minutes late without notice means losing the class, with no refund.
items.conduct: Safety: the academy may refuse anyone showing clear signs of intoxication, drug use or a physical condition that compromises their or the group’s safety, with no refund.
items.health: You must know how to swim and tell the school about any prior injury, medical condition or health issue that could affect surfing before entering the water.
